title: Number Systems Hierarchy Diagram
description: Visual nested Venn diagram illustrating the relationships between natural numbers, whole numbers, integers, rational numbers, and real numbers.
subject: Algebra I
Number Systems and Properties
Number Sets
creator: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Classify numbers as natural, whole, integer, rational, irrational, or real using the nested Venn regions
Explain why every natural number is also a whole number, integer, rational number, and real number
Distinguish rational numbers from irrational numbers as non-overlapping regions inside the real numbers
Identify example numbers for each set (N, W, Z, Q, I, R) using the hover tooltips and definitions
Interpret set-containment notation by mapping the symbols N, W, Z, Q, and R onto the diagram's concentric regions

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive visual modeling with step-by-step exploration and immediate feedback
keyQuestions: What mathematical relationship is illustrated by this model?
How does changing one variable or parameter influence the outcome?
commonMisconceptions: Confusing visual scale or orientation with underlying numeric operations
assessmentOpportunities: Explain the displayed relationship in student's own words
Solve an algebraic problem and confirm result with the interactive model

learningObjectives: Classify numbers into standard nested mathematical sets: Natural (N), Whole (W), Integer (Z), Rational (Q), and Real (R).
prerequisites: Introductory familiarity with variables and algebraic expressions
